summary: DB2CMT is the shared DB2 Commit Controller subroutine. Called with a function code, it manages the transaction boundary: INIT resets counters; CMIT commits (only when the records-processed count reaches the commit frequency, or a force flag is set); RBAK rolls back; SAVE creates a named savepoint; REST rolls back to a savepoint; STAT displays commit/rollback/savepoint counts. SQL failures are logged via DB2ERR and reported via ERRPROC. It centralises commit-frequency and savepoint logic for the batch/DB2 programs.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE function
  WHEN 'INIT': CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
  WHEN 'CMIT': CALL 2000-COMMIT
  WHEN 'RBAK': CALL 3000-ROLLBACK
  WHEN 'SAVE': CALL 4000-SAVEPOINT
  WHEN 'REST': CALL 5000-RESTORE
  WHEN 'STAT': CALL 6000-STATISTICS
  ELSE: SET error; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
END SELECT
RETURN (GOBACK)

paragraphs.name: 2000-COMMIT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
IF records processed >= commit frequency OR force-commit flag set THEN
  CALL 2100-ISSUE-COMMIT
END IF
branches: IF threshold reached OR forced -> commit

annotations.note: Commit only when the caller's processed-count hits the configured frequency (or a force flag) — the caller controls commit cadence.

paragraphs.name: 2100-ISSUE-COMMIT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL COMMIT WORK
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN INCREMENT commit count; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 0
ELSE SET LS-SQLCODE=SQLCODE; msg 'Commit failed'; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 8; CALL 9100-LOG-ERROR END IF
branches: IF commit SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log

paragraphs.name: 3000-ROLLBACK
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL ROLLBACK WORK
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN INCREMENT rollback count; rc=0
ELSE set sqlcode; msg 'Rollback failed'; rc=8; CALL 9100-LOG-ERROR END IF
branches: IF rollback SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log

paragraphs.name: 4000-SAVEPOINT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET WS-SAVEPOINT-ID = LS-SAVEPOINT-NAME
SQL SAVEPOINT :WS-SAVEPOINT-ID ON ROLLBACK RETAIN CURSORS
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN INCREMENT savepoint count; rc=0
ELSE set sqlcode; msg 'Savepoint creation failed'; rc=8; CALL 9100-LOG-ERROR END IF
branches: IF savepoint SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log

paragraphs.name: 5000-RESTORE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET WS-SAVEPOINT-ID = LS-SAVEPOINT-NAME
SQL ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT :WS-SAVEPOINT-ID
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN INCREMENT rollback count; rc=0
ELSE set sqlcode; msg 'Savepoint restore failed'; rc=8; CALL 9100-LOG-ERROR END IF
branches: IF restore SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error+log

paragraphs.name: 6000-STATISTICS
paragraphs.pseudocode: DISPLAY 'DB2 Commit Controller Statistics:' with commit, rollback, and savepoint counts

paragraphs.name: 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: SET ERR-PROGRAM = 'DB2CMT'; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 12; CALL 'ERRPROC' PASSING ERR-MESSAGE

paragraphs.name: 9100-LOG-ERROR
paragraphs.pseudocode: CALL 'DB2ERR' PASSING LS-ERROR-INFO   -- delegate SQL-error logging to the DB2 error handler
